purpose: Implement one peer host-runtime identity contract for Ableton Live, FL Studio, Logic Pro, Pro Tools, Studio One, REAPER and GENERIC_OTHER so active-host context can be exact without becoming product priority, support truth or capability ranking.

lineage.outcome: N0TE knows exactly which creative workspace/runtime is active while all six named DAWs remain peers and the Song remains canonical above them.
lineage.capability: Peer host-family identity and deterministic runtime fingerprint

legacy_rejections: host family embedded in Song identity

completion_proof: six named DAWs plus GENERIC_OTHER construct peer host identities
explicit aliases normalize deterministically and unknown hosts do not silently become GENERIC_OTHER
GENERIC_OTHER requires an explicit host label and distinct labels produce distinct identity
core-host display labels are cosmetic and excluded from fingerprint identity
canonical OS/architecture aliases from PLATFORM-00A converge to the same host fingerprint
version, edition, canonical platform/architecture and translation mode changes invalidate the fingerprint
raw OS/machine spelling and platform target tier are not host identity
repeated identity reads are deterministic and perform no process/filesystem discovery
next_selection_rule: After DAW-00A evidence, reconcile and globally compare the next DAW-00 universal chassis gaps (feature registry/environment evidence, workspace identity, FocusContext, Musical IR, Host Shadow/reconciliation) against preserved PLATFORM-00 and CORE-02. Do not select a named DAW adapter merely because its historical code is mature.
